api.notes: The content shown inside the scrim.
Tri-state: the attribute forces the content open, the property `false` forces it hidden and inert, `undefined` leaves it to `show-on`.
Renamed: an `align` attribute is mapped to text-align by Chrome (A§7.1).

api.reason: A-xstyle: use class/style, ::part(overlay), ::part(scrim) and the tokens.
The host element is the container; use it directly.

hooks.notes: The hook applied overlay behaviour to an existing container; wrap that container's content in tct-overlay, or use the container-reveal styles for a bare reveal.

CSS module for hover/focus reveal inside a container (.reveal-container, .reveal, .reveal-preserved, .conceal, data-reveal-state, data-reveal-visibility, --_hover-delay). Consumed by Thumbnail and TreeList row actions. Filed as a request to move under styles/.
Touch tap-to-toggle uses the same interactive-element guard as the shared clickable container.

keyboard.action: Tab reaches hidden overlay content (it is only transparent) and focus inside the container reveals it while `show-on` is `hover` or `focus`

differences.text: `align` is `alignment`, `scrim={false}` is `scrim="none"`, and `isOpen` is a tri-state (`open` attribute forces open, property `false` forces hidden, `undefined` = `show-on`) (A§7.1, A§7.2).

The media-theme inversion is done by setting `data-media-theme` on each `slot="content"` child (the tokens' `[data-media-theme]` island), because a `<tct-media-theme>` wrapper would have to be rendered around slotted content and document CSS cannot reach an attribute inside the shadow root. The attribute is removed again for `scrim="none"`.
The strip slide is movement, so it only runs without `prefers-reduced-motion: reduce` (the fade stays); upstream zeroes the whole transition.

Hidden overlay content is transparent and click-through, not visibility:hidden as upstream: a hidden control could never receive keyboard focus there, so :focus-within could not reveal it. Here it stays in the tab order and the accessibility tree and reveals when focus reaches it.
The `light` scrim washes with the near-white `--color-on-dark` token at 60% instead of the literal `white`; no colour literals in component CSS (D-013).

requests.reason: useContainerReveal is consumed by other families (Thumbnail, TreeList). Its CSS module is authored at packages/components/src/overlay/container-reveal.styles.css because WP-4 may not write under styles/; move it (git mv) and update the two consumers' imports.

core.overlay.notes: Guides: [mwg:css]; [mwg:interactive-content-reveal] for its accessibility guarantee (revealed content stays keyboard-reachable). tct-overlay has no events (upstream has none) and no strings.
